blocks.content: PART A: BARTER SYSTEM – THE BEGINNING OF EXCHANGE

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The barter system inherently suffers from limitations such as the lack of double coincidence of wants, lack of a common unit of value, and difficulty in deferred payments.
Money arose to eliminate exchange frictions, defined primarily by its general acceptability as a medium of exchange.
Functions of money are broadly classified into Primary (Medium of Exchange, Measure of Value), Secondary (Standard of Deferred Payment, Store of Value, Transfer of Value), and Contingent functions.
Types of money span from Commodity Money and Fiat Money to modern Credit Money and Plastic Money.
Money plays a pivotal role in facilitating liquidity, credit creation, and efficient national income distribution in modern economies.
